text:
maria: quick heads-up — onboarding webhook retries started spiking for a subset of new accounts in eu-west-1 around 10:15 UTC. noticed increased 429s in the logs and a few support tickets. drafting a customer update now.

alex: on it — looks like our ingress rate limiter bumped up after a config diff. rolling a targeted revert to the throttling change. ETA ~10m.

jun: flagging SRE — I see elevated queue latency on the onboarding-pipeline worker group. correlation with the changed limiter rules. have mitigation steps ready if revert doesn't restore throughput.

maria: thanks. need a short status update we can send to affected trial customers and high-touch onboarding. keep it simple: impact, what we're doing, ETA, how we'll follow up with RCA.

lisa: can we include a temporary workaround for customers waiting on webhook callbacks? e.g., retry with exponential backoff + check /webhooks/status endpoint.

alex: yes — add: if you're seeing 429s, retry after 30s with exponential backoff. we'll also add a note about resumed delivery once backfill completes.

maria: draft for review: "We're investigating an issue causing delayed webhook callbacks for some new accounts in eu-west-1. Engineers are reverting a recent rate-limiter change and working to backfill queued webhooks. Expected restoration within 30 minutes. We'll follow up with an RCA and any credits if applicable." thoughts? :thinking_face:

jun: short and clear. add: "No customer data was lost; retries/backfill are in progress."

paul: +1. I'll prepare a tailored note for top 20 onboarding accounts (include account ids) and offer a 1:1 office hour if they want immediate troubleshooting.

maria: perfect. alex, confirm when revert is live and if we need a second mitigation (scale up worker pool) after revert.

alex: revert started at 10:24 UTC. ingress 429 rate dropped ~60% already. continuing monitoring. if we hit >80% reduction we can avoid scale-up; otherwise I’ll trigger worker autoscale.

opsbot: deploy-tracker: Revert to limiter-config v1.14 initiated by alex at 10:24:12 UTC — status: in_progress.

jun: monitoring dashboards show queue depth decreasing, webhook success rate climbing. looks stable at the moment but keeping alarm thresholds lowered for 2 hours.

maria: sending the customer-facing update now. I'll post the tailored high-touch list to the ops-runbook and tag people for follow-ups. please add any postmortem notes to the incident channel afterwards.

lisa: post-send: a few customers asked for ETA on backfill. recommend offering a clear window and a small usage credit for affected trials — reduces churn risk.

paul: noted. I'll draft the credits note and include renewal-risk flags for any accounts with renewals in 30 days.

maria: thanks team. next steps: alex confirm revert complete, jun prep short RCA outline (root cause + mitigation + permanent fix timeline), paul assemble high-touch list and credits proposal. I'll own customer comms and capture feedback.

alex: revert finished at 10:31 UTC, ingress 429s down to baseline. marking as mitigated — will follow up with config test plan to avoid recurrence.

opsbot: incident-log: incident 2026-03-21-3391123581 mitigated at 10:31:45 UTC.

jun: starting RCA doc skeleton — will post draft in #incidents in 1 hour with timeline and remediation items.

maria: closing loop here. I posted the customer update and the tailored outreach list. will ping when RCA draft is ready. thanks :raised_hands:
__notes: This thread simulates a customer-success channel coordination on incident comms: short Slack-style messages, @mentions, a bot status, and concrete next steps. All fields are strings or lists of strings per agents.md schema.
